premises.text: Users expect data continuity across devices for apps.
premises.evidence_span: app users expect to have access to their most recent data anytime, anywhere.

premises.text: Over 90% of developers want to build cross-platform apps.
premises.evidence_span: Over 90% of developers want to build cross-platform apps.

premises.text: Existing backend solutions are limited and costly for developers.
premises.evidence_span: iCloud, but that only works for Apple devices, and a lot of developers hate working with it.

premises.text: NimbusBase leverages personal clouds to store app data.
premises.evidence_span: NimbusBase is the first mobile and web backend to leverage app users' personal clouds, like Dropbox and Google Drive, to store app data.

premises.text: NimbusBase allows users to store and sync data easily across devices.
premises.evidence_span: data is instantly synced between the two.

premises.text: NimbusBase provides users with control over their data.
premises.evidence_span: you can personally delete your data for your apps.

premises.text: NimbusBase saves developers time and money by removing backend setup.
premises.evidence_span: Nimbus Space reduces the time developers spend setting up a backend from months to minutes.

value.text: Users gain data continuity and control over their app data.
value.evidence_span: data continuity across devices, and lets you have complete control over all your apps.

notes: No separate premises for the benefits to developers as they are part of the same value proposition.
